== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Grun Galesurge]] ([[Ring of Fire]])

== Hero Usage ==
* Heroes use Shield of Deflection under two criteria:
** They will use it in response to an ally being attacked by melee or ranged attacks.
** They will use it on an ally whose health has fallen below 50%, even if that ally is not under attack or receiving damage.
